+import React, {
+  memo,
+} from "react";
+import {
+  View,
+  TouchableOpacity,
+  Dimensions,
+} from "react-native";
+import { ThemeContext } from "@style/theme/theme-context.tsx";
+import type { Theme } from "@types/Theme.ts";
+import styles from "./global-medical-network-screen.styles";
+import {
+  SVGSmallClockCircleComponent,
+  SVGArrowRightGreenComponent,
+} from '../../assets/svg/index.ts';
+import AppText from "@components/app-text/app-text";
+import NavigationBar from "@components/navigation-bar/navigation-bar.tsx";
+import PageRightBt from "@components/page-right-bt/page-right-bt.tsx";
+import { TabView, SceneMap, TabBar, TabBarIndicator } from 'react-native-tab-view';
+import MedicalServiceScreen from "../medical-service-screen/medical-service-screen.tsx";
+import RescueServiceScreen from "../rescue-service-screen/rescue-service-screen.tsx";
+const GlobalMedicalNetworkScreen = () => {
+  const [index, setIndex] = React.useState(0);
+  const [routes] = React.useState([
+    { key: "first", title: $i18n.t("medical_service") },
+    { key: "second", title: $i18n.t("rescue_service") },
+  ]);
+
+  const renderCustomIndicator = (indicatorProps) => {
+    return (
+      <TabBarIndicator
+        {...indicatorProps}
+        style={[
+          indicatorProps.style,
+          {
+            width: '24%',
+            alignSelf: 'center',
+            marginLeft: '13%',
+          }
+        ]}
+      />
+    );
+  };
+
+  const renderOpeningHours = () => {
+    return (
+      <TouchableOpacity
+        onPress={() => $NavigationActions.navigate($routeNames.openingHoursScreen)}
+        style={styles.openningHoursContainer}
+        activeOpacity={0.7}
+      >
+        <View style={[styles.openingServiceHoursContainer, styles.containerOpeningHours]}>
+          <View style={styles.openingHoursInnerContainer}>
+            <SVGSmallClockCircleComponent width={16} height={16} style={{ marginRight: 8 }} />
+            <AppText
+              size="medium"
+              style={{
+                color: '#00AC86',
+                flex: 1,
+              }} ellipsizeMode="tail" numberOfLines={1}>
+              {$i18n.t('openingHoursService')}
+            </AppText>
+          </View>
+          <SVGArrowRightGreenComponent width={16} height={16} />
+        </View>
+      </TouchableOpacity>
+    )
+  }
+  const renderTabBar = (props) => (
+    <>
+      <TabBar
+        {...props}
+        indicatorStyle={{ backgroundColor: "#00AC86" }}
+        style={{ backgroundColor: "white" }}
+        activeColor={'#00AC86'}
+        inactiveColor={'#8D9796'}
+        renderIndicator={renderCustomIndicator}
+      />
+      {renderOpeningHours()}
+    </>
+  );
+
+  const renderScene = SceneMap({
+    first: MedicalServiceScreen,
+    second: RescueServiceScreen,
+  });
+
+  return (
+    <ThemeContext.Consumer>
+      {(theme: Theme) => {
+        return (
+          <>
+            <NavigationBar
+              title={$i18n.t("global_medical_network")}
+              rightBt={<PageRightBt tag={$routeNames.GlobalMedicalNetworkScreen} />}
+            />
+            <TabView
+              renderTabBar={renderTabBar}
+              navigationState={{ index, routes }}
+              renderScene={renderScene}
+              onIndexChange={setIndex}
+              initialLayout={{ width: Dimensions.get('window').width }}
+            />
+          </>
+        );
+      }}
+    </ThemeContext.Consumer>
+  );
+};
+
+export default memo(GlobalMedicalNetworkScreen);
